definitions.basis: AI-drafted comparisons of the debate batch's definition records; every cell cites words of the record's quote or of further lines of the same pinned PDF; every cell and statement passed two blind AI checks, tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed them

excluded: legacy research pages and network assets
record explorer page (replaced by the record graph)

first_test.basis: summary of the usefulness exam of 24 to 31 October 2026, written by web/site_product_v1/usefulness_v1/make_summary.py from the exam's run record; answers, grades and side-by-side verdicts are by AI; no person has reviewed them

gap_closing.basis: each counted item passed two blind AI checks tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed it

decision.rule: Move out records that are not relevant to AI safety and will never be used; keep anything that can connect to, support or be used by AI-safety work later.

proof_dependencies.basis: the records in the out-of-scope list's proof-support groups and every link that touches them, copied unchanged from the canonical view; moved out of the AI-safety atlas by the maintainer on 2026-11-01 and kept here so each proof still lists what it rests on

decision.rule: Move out records that are not relevant to AI safety and will never be used; keep anything that can connect to, support or be used by AI-safety work later.

publication_provenance.scope: Explorer export of the merged canonical commit; canonical pins are retained. Separate Lean extracts and Metamath sidecar excluded.
publication_provenance.source_generator: AGR_Atlas_Infrastructure/ontology_v2/explorer_v1/build.py run in a clean worktree of canonical_source_commit

record_graph.basis: groups from Louvain community detection over the recorded links, with a weaker tie for records that quote the same source; positions are navigation, not evidence

replications.basis: AI-drafted questions over the debate batch's results and main claims; every answer, finding and setting cites words of the record's quote or of further lines of the same pinned PDF; every entry passed two blind AI checks, tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed them

snapshot.scope: joined view at the canonical commit, less 526 out-of-scope records; 1224 records; public presentation snapshot

story.basis: every number and picture is counted from data.json, the public view, graph.json, coverage_map.json and first_test.json; only story_status.json (which tools are live, how each pipeline stage runs, the latest news) is written by hand; the AI safety coverage map is an AI-drafted outline marked against the atlas's sources, not reviewed by a person; overview.html only forwards

understanding.basis: AI-drafted plain-language cards for the debate batch's results; every line cites words of the record's quote, of further lines of the same pinned PDF, or of atlas text; every card passed two blind AI checks, tested on planted errors; no person has reviewed them

visual_atlas.basis: selects and joins fields of the debate batch, its AI review states and the gap-closing pilot; adds no claim; no person has reviewed it
